description.zh:
待提取水印的视频文件。


> - OSS文件/媒资的地域需要与当前IMS所在地域保持一致。
description.en:
The input video from which to extract the watermark.

> - The OSS object or media asset must be in the same region as your IMS service.

description.zh:
提取任务参数，JSONString。目前支持设置参数如下：

- m3u8Type：算法类型，默认值为v1。

  - v1：提取绝对路径的m3u8。
  - v2：提取相对路径的m3u8。
description.en:
Extraction job parameters, specified as a JSON string. The following parameters are supported:

- `m3u8Type`: The algorithm type. The default value is `v1`.

  - `v1`: Extracts an m3u8 playlist with absolute paths.

  - `v2`: Extracts an m3u8 playlist with relative paths.

description.zh: 用户自定义数据，最大长度1024字节。
description.en: The user-defined data. Maximum length: 1,024 bytes.

title.zh: 提交溯源水印提取作业

descriptions.zh:
- 目前数字水印相关接口只支持华东2（上海）、华北2（北京）地域使用。

- 溯源水印提取仅支持3min以上的视频，小于则任务会失败。

- 该接口为[异步接口](~~3027141~~)，提交任务后返回任务ID（此时任务尚未完成，任务将进入后台排队异步执行），最终结果将通过回调通知，也可通过[查询溯源水印提取作业](~~2862130~~)主动查询任务状态。
descriptions.en:
- The digital watermarking APIs are available only in the China (Shanghai) and China (Beijing) regions.

- Trace watermark extraction is supported only for videos that are 3 minutes or longer. Jobs for shorter videos will fail.

- This is an [asynchronous API](~~3027141~~). After you submit a job, a job ID is returned. The job is not immediately complete and is queued for asynchronous processing. You can get the final result through a callback notification or check the job status by calling the [GetTraceExtractJob](~~2862130~~) operation.
